name: nl-30-percent-ruling
description: Netherlands 30% ruling (expat scheme, expatregeling) for employees recruited or seconded from abroad, tax year 2026: who qualifies (150 km rule, PhD and returning-employee exceptions, the 2026 salary norms of EUR 48,013 and EUR 36,497), the 30% tax-free allowance for 2026 and the cut to 27% from 1 January 2027 written into the law, the transitional rule that keeps 30% for rulings applied by the last pay period of 2023, the WNT cap (EUR 262,000, so EUR 78,600 a year), the 4-month application window, the 5-year term and earlier-stay reductions, the annual choice against actual costs, penalties and interest, and the end of partial non-resident status after the 2026 return.
